reviews.t: I like Beardsmen's Bold Forest the best

It is not that bright refreshing Citrus smell that you might be anticipating. It is more of a clove with citrus in the background. When you put it in your hands and onto your beard you smell the Citrus right away. It does smell like cloves, and giving it the benefit of the doubt, I got it because it was a big bottle and had good reviews. reviews.t: If you do not like the clove scent then stay away from this product
reviews.x: I am down to the last few drops of my first bottle, this stuff is really quality for the price, you really can't beat it. All natural ingredients, just carrier oils and essential oils for scent. The scent is the only thing that leaves a bit to be desired. I really don't mind the scent, but it is listed as 'Rousing Citrus', but honestly I can only smell cloves. If you do not like the clove scent then stay away from this product.

reviews.t: Great product, even better value.
reviews.x: This is my third bottle of oil from Beardsmen Spirit. This is my first time ordering the Rousing Citrus scent; the previous two bottles were the Forest. I really like this scent, though it has stronger hints of clove than citrus. I tend to get bad beardruff and this product keeps it in check while also softening my beard. You can't beat the value either! I also use their mustache wax which does a great job of keeping the whiskers tamed without feeling sticky or stiff. I have, and will continue t

reviews.t: Smells like Goth Kid...
reviews.x: The oil itself is great... the scent... not so much. I got this because they no longer sell the forest scent. Be aware this smells like clove cigarettes. That's it. You will smell like the goth kid from high school who smoked those nasty black clove cigarettes behind the bleachers and talked about nihlism. If that's what you're into than this is the oil for you. I bought two bottles. One for me and one for a buddy. He absolutely loves it. Just be aware there is no "Citrus" scent to this.

reviews.t: If there's citrus in there I can't smell it.
reviews.x: I ordered this brand before in the cedar sent and liked it enough to buy the same brand again. Unfortunately they do not offer the cedar sent anymore. We received this bottle with the sealed for you protection label stuck to the inside of the cap and the bottle was very oily. Not sure if I just got a bad bottle or if this is just poor quality control of the company. Also for this product itself the sent is very foul. It does not smell anything like citrus and had a rotten smell to it.

reviews.t: smells great and works like a charm!!
reviews.x: this is the third oil i have bought for my husband from this company!! he absolutely loves this brand and having scents to choose from. we love them all. this citrus scent and the tea tree are by far both of out favorites out of all the oils he owns :) he always had an itchy flaky beard before the oils and now he has an awesome beard!! i definitely recommend this brand!! they are awesome and smell amazing!! i got a discount on ours. and the bottle size is manly!

reviews.t: More "Clove-y" then "Citrus-y"
reviews.x: I really like this product. This is the 3rd or 4th bottle of Beard Oil I have ordered from them. Generally I use the Unscented but I decided to switch it up.  I tried the Rousing Citrus, but I was a little unhappy, the citrus smells much more like Clove.  The Beard Oil is still a good product, but the clove scent it too much.  Wish they would've named it by the correct scent, for that reason I gave it 3 stars instead of 4 or 5.

reviews.t: Really nice product
reviews.x: I didn't like my last beard oils dripper cap because it left my bottle exposed to spills, this "beardsmen" oil has a top that drips drops into your palm with no problem and no worries of large spills.  The size and price make this a no brainer to me. I have been satisfied with its effectiveness and the scent is FANTASTIC! Kinda smells of man and citrus, women love it! I'll be buying more, eventually, since this is 4oz!

reviews.t: Great beard oil
reviews.x: Good product, works well when used in tandem w/the Beardesman beard balm. I citrus scent is not overpowering at al & leaves your beard feeling soft & conditioned. The size of this bottle (4oz) is great! I don't think I've come across another company yet that offers a 4oz bottle, & you can't beat the price either. This will definitely be a repeat purchase for me when the time comes.

reviews.t: Cloves, cloves and more cloves. If you're trying to snatch a gingerbread lady, that's your scent.
reviews.x: So the name of this beard oil is misleading. It reads Rousing Citrus, but in reality it smells very strongly of cloves and cinnamon with subtle citrus scent. Needless to say this didn't go over well with the missus who isn't a fan of cloves. And neither am I. The scent is overwhelming and very strong leaving your beard smelling like a poorly spiced autumn baking project.

claims.text: Many reviewers note the scent smells more like clove than citrus, which some find unexpected or disappointing.
Reviewers praise the oil for making beards soft, manageable, and less rough or scratchy.
Customers consider it good quality and good value, especially given the large 4 oz bottle.
The shaker/orifice reducer top is appreciated for being easy to use and preventing spills.
Some reviewers prefer other scents in the line, such as Tea Tree or Forest, over this one.
